concepts.title: 01 Dispatch Desk
concepts.detail: DIRECTION 01 — DISPATCH DESK. A tactile neighbourhood operations desk with a compact wine top bar, gold 'TODAY'S DESK' label, bold asymmetric welcome panel and a tiny pixel streetlight illustration. Three compact tabbed statistic tickets across the width. Main focal panel 'Needs attention' resembles neatly stacked maintenance job tickets with cherry urgency ribbons, short location text and strong gold Review reports action. Below place a horizontal upcoming event strip and two unequal sized action tiles for Manage activities and World editor, with pixel calendar and neighbourhood block motifs. Bottom navigation Workspace, Reports, Activities, World. Warm vanilla background, generous whitespace, sophisticated editorial composition. Lively without clutter.

params.prompt: Create one polished high-fidelity mobile web SDP staff dashboard UI concept for KoBi — Komuniti Bijak, a neighbourhood maintenance and community participation demo. Straight-on flat screen design filling entire 9:16 image, no phone bezel, no perspective, no presentation board, no multiple variants. Professional yet warm civic toolkit, memorable art direction, practical readable touch targets, excellent spacing. STRICT interface palette ONLY wine #6C1A21, cherry #B92C2C, gold #CEA257, sand #D1BF9A, vanilla #E5E0CD. No white, black, green, blue, gradients, glassmorphism or extra colours. Bungee font for titles, logo, section headers and every button; Yanone Kaffeesatz for body and supporting text. English text only. Pixel Stickers design vocabulary: crisp thin wine outlines, restrained stepped corners, offset hard shadows, clipped ticket actions, tiny folded paper accents. Pixel illustration limited to purposeful neighbourhood motifs, never childish gaming UI. No AI assistant, coins, shop, authentication or real submission claims. Persistently show small 'Demo mode' badge and 'Sample data' near records. Brand 'KoBi', page heading 'SDP workspace', township 'Elmina'. Useful content: 12 Open reports, 4 In progress, 3 Upcoming activities. Actions 'Review reports', 'Manage activities', 'World editor'. Priority report 'Streetlight not working' at 'Frekuensi 2', another 'Park bench repair' at 'Central park'. Upcoming 'Community clean-up' with '24 Oct · 8:00 AM'. Clear hierarchy of what needs attention and what staff can do. Main focus is an engaging genuinely usable dashboard, not a generic empty card grid. DIRECTION 01 — DISPATCH DESK. concepts.title: 02 Neighbourhood Control Map
concepts.detail: DIRECTION 02 — NEIGHBOURHOOD CONTROL MAP. Map-first staff dashboard. A restrained header and compact heading, then a large illustrated angled top-down 2D pixel neighbourhood map as the hero, entirely in the five approved colours, featuring houses, streets, park, hall, three numbered maintenance pins and subtle wine labels. No isometric 3D buildings. Map occupies about one third of the page, framed with slim wine border and gold corner tabs. Small gold overlay '3 locations need attention'. Beneath hero a single clean integrated status rail with 12 Open, 4 In progress, 3 Activities. Follow with an elegant priority report drawer, a large Review reports ticket action, and two smaller paired Manage activities / World editor buttons. Compact upcoming event strip. Bottom navigation. Sense of place and useful civic control, not a video game HUD.

concepts.title: 03 Community Bulletin
concepts.detail: DIRECTION 03 — COMMUNITY BULLETIN. A beautifully art-directed civic noticeboard on vanilla, editorial newspaper-like hierarchy and tactile clipped paper construction. Oversized Bungee 'SDP WORKSPACE' title with an elegant gold underline and small date strip. Three small metric stamps on one ruled horizontal line. Large central wine bulletin panel with vanilla headline 'Your neighbourhood, in motion', small monochrome pixel streetscape border and the strongest gold 'Review reports' ticket. Below, a carefully ordered 'Priority board' with two maintenance notices, paper-fold corner accents and cherry status tabs; an upcoming activity announcement appears as an overlapping but fully legible gold ticket beside a World editor mini card. Manage activities button clearly present. Use visual rhythm, asymmetry and strong typography, very readable, avoid distress/grunge and clutter. Bottom navigation.

concepts.title: 04 Operations Bento
concepts.detail: DIRECTION 04 — OPERATIONS BENTO. A confident modern dashboard with wine hero and disciplined asymmetric bento composition, adapted to a narrow mobile screen. Slim brand header, bold 'Good morning, SDP' and smaller 'SDP workspace'. Hero has huge vanilla 12 and 'Open reports', tiny pixel maintenance worker beside lamp, gold Review reports ticket. Beneath create a refined two-column composition: small sand '4 In progress' tile with stepped progress motif, taller vanilla '3 Upcoming activities' tile with small pixel calendar and Manage activities action. A full-width World editor tile shows a cropped monochrome pixel neighbourhood plan and crisp CTA. One compact 'Needs attention' row and one 'Next activity' row follow. Carefully controlled negative space and thin borders, no heavy outlines around every object, no generic charts, no arbitrary dashboard stats. Bottom navigation with gold selected Workspace.
